messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

For generations, our foundry has taken great pride in supplying our regional partners with the utmost care and quality. To continue serving you with the craftsmanship you expect from us, we must account for our rising expenses. Over the past twelve months, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost.

Taking these developments into consideration, we are pleased to present our offer for a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our long-standing relationship deeply and look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Dear colleagues at Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG,

Thank you for your letter and for setting out your position.

By the figures you gave us - LCI-C +2.7% at 30% of your cost, PPI-C241 +6.5% at 24% of your cost - the weighted effect on the price is about +2.4%, not the 9.5% you ask for. Your letter gives us only 51 days of notice (doc:20260911-70110-P01, ctr:4600070110). Our contract requires 90 days. The German labour cost index for manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).

The data does not support your price as it stands; the options below follow from it.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 131.25 per unit, payment 90 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.
Option B: EUR 129.72 per unit, payment 30 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.
Option C: EUR 130.08 per unit, payment 45 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part - material, conversion, overhead?

We are happy to go through the figures together.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose. We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. 

As a family-owned foundry, we maintain strict confidentiality regarding our internal cost breakdowns and cannot share them. Our costs move with LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351; the figures stay with us.

At our standard terms, our Angebot is a price of €135.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. In the spirit of our long-standing partnership, we are willing to concede the effective date to 2027-01-01, provided we agree on a price of €135.70 per unit with 30-day payment terms.

We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands. Our offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Dear colleagues at Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG,

Thank you for your reply and for the steps you have made - we appreciate it.

Your on-time delivery over the last four quarters was 85.2% (sc:70110@2026Q3). German producer prices for electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).

We are close now; the options below are a fair way to close the remaining gap.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 134.99 per unit, payment 90 days net, new price from 2027-01-01.
Option B: EUR 132.87 per unit, payment 30 days net, new price from 2027-01-01.
Option C: EUR 133.40 per unit, payment 45 days net, new price from 2027-01-01.

Which cost elements of this part have actually risen since our last price agreement?

We would be glad to finalise on this basis.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains. Our costs move with LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351; the figures stay with us. As a family-owned foundry, we maintain strict confidentiality and do not disclose internal cost breakdowns. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

Building on your Option B, we propose a price of €133.40 per unit with 30-day payment terms, effective 2027-01-01. This offer carries a price of €133.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 January 2027. It remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.body:
Guten Tag,

It is always a pleasure to reach out to our valued partners at Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. We note your latest proposal, but we see that your offered price has decreased compared to your previous message. Over the years, our family-run foundry has always valued our close relationship, and we have already made significant concessions in the spirit of our partnership and cannot accommodate any further reductions. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Therefore, a price of €133.40 per unit, effective 1 January 2027 with Zahlungsziel 30 days net, is our final offer. Please note that our Angebot stays valid for 7 days. 

We trust in your understanding and hope to continue our successful collaboration.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
